iter_evals.query: YouTube influencer vlog sponsored by Surfshark VPN targeting/appealing to minors: search FTC Act §5 endorsement disclosure rules and .com Disclosures, FTC Endorsement Guides (16 CFR Part 255), COPPA where relevant, UK CAP Code/ASA guidance on ad recognition by children and identifiable influencer marketing (#ad, sponsorship disclosure prominence), and UCPD/AVMSD rules on covert commercial communications. Include authorities/guidance on misleading VPN/security efficacy claims, claims about accessing geo-restricted streaming libraries/government websites, affiliate promo codes and links, and any child-directed advertising standards or direct exhortation rules applicable to online creator content for under-18 audiences.

Find current advertising and consumer protection law/guidance applicable to influencer endorsements of VPN/cybersecurity services, especially claims about security/privacy, malware alerts, public Wi‑Fi protection, IP switching/access to geo-restricted content, and required sponsorship disclosures. Prioritize FTC Endorsement Guides and .com Disclosures, UK ASA/CAP Code and CMA influencer guidance, and Canadian Competition Bureau guidance on deceptive marketing/performance claims for digital services.

Find applicable advertising/endorsement and consumer protection rules for influencer YouTube sponsorships of VPN/cybersecurity services, especially in Canada and platform guidance: FTC Endorsement Guides disclosure requirements, Competition Act misleading advertising, Ad Standards Canada influencer disclosure guidance, and any law/guidance on unsubstantiated claims for VPN/security features, malware alerts, public Wi‑Fi protection, access to geo-restricted streaming/government websites, and privacy/data protection claims.
